scope: Capture one Measure recipe per watch and bind it across resumes

reproduction.reason: Editing the same Measure settings file between real TIFF fields changed the applied second-field recipe

validation.new_recipe_test_execution: real watcher, field adapter and SQLite collection; mask and Measure stand-ins record applied recipes

coverage: settings file mutation cannot change recipes between fields of the same run
each field receives a deep copy
same-path recipe change refuses populated resume before output writes
same semantic content at moved path with different formatting and src remains compatible
populated legacy ledger without recipe digest refuses without alteration
mask-only watches ignore Measure settings files
empty watch records can select another recipe
limits: Fingerprint covers explicit loaded Measure inputs or default channel inputs, not all expanded software defaults
Referenced model/template/other external file content is not fingerprinted
Mask-model settings remain outside this bounded recipe guard
F548 remains partial for vendor completion, unsupported series, pooled normalization and other recorded requirements
